LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.label: Opened Can of WellCheers
LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.description: Opened Can of WellCheers (F-05-52) is a bright beverage dispenser tended by tiny shrimp fishermen.\nSatisfactory work yields Red, Blue, or Purple cans that heal flesh or restore sanity; poor work puts the drinker into freezing hypothermic slumber.
